_comment: Submit via WhatsApp Manager or POST https://graph.facebook.com/{version}/{WABA_ID}/message_templates. Category UTILITY (post-transaction follow-up). Params: 1=customer first name, 2=branch name, 3=service, 4=vehicle reg. Quick-reply payloads are set per message (RATE_GREAT:<request_id>) so each tap maps to the exact job.
